name: m4-main-int148-jdk26-scala
description: Full compile of the scala corpus (library, reflect, compiler) on the M4, with xctrace ipc: 2.13.x (main) vs retronym's refreshed `scala2-perf-integration` with retronym/scala#148 (int148), each build in its own forks (one scala-library each, so not paired).

All builds compiled with the release optimizer settings (`-opt:l:inline -opt-inline-from:scala/**`, the lab's `SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26 (`jdk26-integration-branch-e9e67e`), 8G heap, the corpus compiled against JDK 25's API (`jdkHome=25.0.4-tem`: compiler-benchmark's `scala` clashes with JDK 26's `Comparator.max`), 6 × 20 s warmup, 6 × 20 s measured, 2 rounds. Follows `m4-release-main-int-jdk26` (scalap).

variantDescriptions.int148: int + retronym/scala#148 (typing transformers' contexts made lazily), `70634e2e68`
